- **Choose the video you want to edit or follow.** The **[Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)** is your source video. Editing tasks make a changed version of it. The three **Follow** tasks use its layout, movement or outlines to guide a new video. Drag that video from Assets onto a **Video** lane, then right-click its clip and choose **Convert to Driver**. It moves to **Driver** and disappears from normal preview; the original file stays in Assets.
- **Guide the result with a picture.** Drag a picture from Assets onto **[Guides](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#guide-frames)** at the frame it should guide. For **Edit With a Picture**, use a picture you have already edited and place it at **In**.
- **Add existing sound.** Drag a sound file from Assets onto **[Audio](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#audio-tracks)**. To add a video's picture and sound together, drop the video onto the [numbered ruler](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline) above the timeline lanes. Dropping onto **Video** adds only the picture.
- **Keep the original sound while editing the picture.** Keep its Audio clip unmuted and choose **Modes → Sound → Use Timeline Audio**. To make replacement sound instead, choose **Generate New Audio** and mute any old Audio clips you do not want playing after the result arrives.

**Check the processed Driver.** Choose **Follow Scene Layout**, **Follow Body Movement**, or **Follow Outlines** under **Modes → Task**. Open a viewport pane's source menu and choose **Processed Driver**. Click that pane's **Run** to preview the depth, pose, or outlines without running diffusion. Each Follow task enables only its matching processing group and this preview. - **Watch your result.** With **Controls → Editor → Save as: Take**, each result appears as a new timeline clip. A [take](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#takes) is one generated version. Click **Play** below the preview. If the clip is muted, right-click it and choose **Unmute Selected**.
- **Choose the version to keep.** In **Assets**, double-click a result and open **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**. Back on the timeline, keep the winner visible on **Video** and mute competing takes. A favorite star marks an asset; it does not choose the version used in your video.
- **Check the soundtrack.** Keep only the sound you want playing. Linked picture and sound mute together; to mute just one, right-click its clip and choose **[Unlink Linked Items](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#linked-groups)** first.
- **Save your finished video.** Click **[Export](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#export-timeline)** above the timeline. 1. **Keep the part you like.** Leave your chosen video visible on a **Video** lane. If an original Driver is still active, hide it using the eye at the left of its lane.
2. **Set the total length.** Increase **Frames** at the right of the toolbar above the timeline. At **24 FPS**, **241 frames** is about **10 seconds** in total.
3. **Choose the picture and sound for the new part.** Set **Modes → Task → Make a New Video**. Under **Modes → Sound**, choose **Use Timeline Audio** for existing sound, or **Generate New Audio** to make sound too. Existing Audio needs to cover the finished length when you use it.
4. **Choose only the part you are adding.** Set **[In](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** at the end of the kept video and **Out** at the new end. Press **Enter** after each value.
5. **Help the new part match.** Above the timeline, **[Ctx: Pre](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#the-generation-window)** includes earlier frames as a reference. Start with **49**, or fewer if your kept video is shorter. Keep **Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0**.
6. **Describe what happens next.** Double-click empty **Prompt** space at the start of the new part, type your description and click **Create**.
7. **Generate and check the join.** Generate the selected range, then play across the join to check the picture, motion and sound.
